HEA_BEG_004: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM appointments;
HEA_BEG_005: SELECT * FROM appointments ORDER BY bill_amount DESC;
HEA_BEG_006: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM doctors ORDER BY category;
HEA_BEG_007: SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE appointment_date >= DATE '2026-01-01';
HEA_BEG_009: SELECT * FROM patients ORDER BY patient_id LIMIT 5;
HEA_BEG_010: SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE bill_amount BETWEEN 25000 AND 75000;
HEA_BEG_011: SELECT * FROM patients WHERE patient_name LIKE 'A%';
HEA_BEG_012: SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE status IN ('Active','Pending');
HEA_BEG_014: SELECT * FROM visits WHERE visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30';
HEA_BEG_015: SELECT AVG(bill_amount) AS average_amount FROM appointments;
HEA_BEG_016: SELECT MAX(amount) AS largest_amount FROM visits;
HEA_BEG_017: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS city_count FROM patients;
HEA_BEG_019: SELECT appointment_id, bill_amount, CASE WHEN bill_amount >= 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN bill_amount >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS amount_band FROM appointments ORDER BY appointment_id;
HEA_BEG_020: SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE status = 'Active' AND bill_amount >= 50000;
HEA_INT_001: SELECT m.patient_name, r.appointment_id, r.status, r.bill_amount FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id ORDER BY m.patient_id,r.appointment_id;
HEA_INT_002: SELECT c.doctor_name, COUNT(r.appointment_id) AS record_count FROM doctors c LEFT JOIN appointments r ON c.doctor_id=r.doctor_id GROUP BY c.doctor_id,c.doctor_name ORDER BY c.doctor_id;
HEA_INT_003: SELECT r.appointment_id FROM appointments r LEFT JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id WHERE e.visit_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_INT_004: SELECT r.appointment_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) AS total_amount FROM appointments r LEFT JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_INT_005: SELECT r.appointment_id, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount FROM appointments r JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id HAVING SUM(e.amount)>20000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
HEA_INT_006: SELECT m.segment, COUNT(r.appointment_id) AS record_count FROM patients m LEFT JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id GROUP BY m.segment ORDER BY m.segment;
HEA_INT_007: SELECT c.category, AVG(r.bill_amount) AS average_amount FROM doctors c JOIN appointments r ON c.doctor_id=r.doctor_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
HEA_INT_008: SELECT m.patient_name, r.appointment_id, c.doctor_name, r.status FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id JOIN doctors c ON r.doctor_id=c.doctor_id ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_INT_009: SELECT m.patient_id,m.patient_name,SUM(r.bill_amount) AS total_amount FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id GROUP BY m.patient_id,m.patient_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
HEA_INT_010: SELECT appointment_id,bill_amount FROM appointments WHERE bill_amount>(SELECT AVG(bill_amount) FROM appointments) ORDER BY bill_amount DESC;
HEA_INT_011: SELECT e.visit_id,e.visit_date,e.visit_type,e.amount,r.status AS record_status FROM visits e JOIN appointments r ON e.appointment_id=r.appointment_id ORDER BY e.visit_id;
HEA_INT_012: SELECT r.appointment_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount FROM appointments r LEFT JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_INT_013: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',visit_date)::date AS event_month,COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM visits GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',visit_date) ORDER BY event_month;
HEA_INT_014: SELECT m.patient_id,m.patient_name FROM patients m LEFT JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id WHERE r.appointment_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.patient_id;
HEA_INT_015: SELECT c.doctor_id,c.doctor_name FROM doctors c LEFT JOIN appointments r ON c.doctor_id=r.doctor_id WHERE r.appointment_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.doctor_id;
HEA_INT_016: SELECT m.patient_id,m.patient_name,MIN(r.appointment_date) AS first_date FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id GROUP BY m.patient_id,m.patient_name ORDER BY m.patient_id;
HEA_INT_017: SELECT r.appointment_id,MAX(e.visit_date) AS latest_event_date FROM appointments r LEFT JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_INT_018: SELECT DISTINCT m.patient_id,m.patient_name FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id WHERE e.status='Completed' ORDER BY m.patient_id;
HEA_INT_019: SELECT c.category,AVG(e.amount) AS average_event_amount FROM doctors c JOIN appointments r ON c.doctor_id=r.doctor_id JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
HEA_INT_020: SELECT m.segment,r.status,COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id GROUP BY m.segment,r.status ORDER BY m.segment,r.status;
HEA_EXP_001: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.patient_id,m.patient_name,SUM(e.amount) total_amount FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY m.patient_id,m.patient_name) SELECT patient_id,patient_name,total_amount,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM totals ORDER BY amount_rank,patient_id;
HEA_EXP_002: SELECT r.appointment_id,MAX(e.visit_date) AS latest_event_date FROM appointments r LEFT JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id HAVING MAX(e.visit_date)<DATE '2026-01-01' OR MAX(e.visit_date) IS NULL ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_EXP_003: WITH totals AS (SELECT patient_id,SUM(bill_amount) total_amount FROM appointments GROUP BY patient_id) SELECT patient_id,total_amount FROM totals WHERE total_amount>(SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM totals) ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
HEA_EXP_004: SELECT appointment_id,bill_amount,CASE WHEN bill_amount>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN bill_amount>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_band FROM appointments ORDER BY appointment_id;
HEA_EXP_005: WITH monthly AS (SELECT appointment_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',visit_date)::date event_month,SUM(amount) monthly_amount FROM visits GROUP BY appointment_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',visit_date)) SELECT appointment_id,event_month,monthly_amount,LAG(monthly_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY appointment_id ORDER BY event_month) previous_month_amount FROM monthly ORDER BY appointment_id,event_month;
HEA_EXP_006: SELECT appointment_id,visit_id,visit_date,amount,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY appointment_id ORDER BY visit_date,visit_id) running_amount FROM visits ORDER BY appointment_id,visit_date,visit_id;
HEA_EXP_007: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY appointment_id ORDER BY amount DESC,visit_id) rn FROM visits e) SELECT visit_id,appointment_id,amount FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY appointment_id,rn;
HEA_EXP_008: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.appointment_id,COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) total_amount FROM appointments r LEFT JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id) SELECT appointment_id,total_amount,ROUND(100.0*total_amount/NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER(),0),2) percent_of_total FROM totals ORDER BY appointment_id;
HEA_EXP_009: SELECT patient_id,appointment_id,bill_amount,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY bill_amount DESC) amount_rank FROM appointments ORDER BY patient_id,amount_rank,appointment_id;
HEA_EXP_010: SELECT appointment_id,visit_id,visit_date,amount,LAG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY appointment_id ORDER BY visit_date,visit_id) previous_amount FROM visits ORDER BY appointment_id,visit_date,visit_id;
HEA_EXP_011: SELECT appointment_id,visit_id,visit_date,amount,AVG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY appointment_id ORDER BY visit_date,visit_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) moving_average FROM visits ORDER BY appointment_id,visit_date,visit_id;
HEA_EXP_012: SELECT m.patient_id,m.patient_name FROM patients m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appointments r WHERE r.patient_id=m.patient_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appointments r WHERE r.patient_id=m.patient_id AND r.status<>'Active') ORDER BY m.patient_id;
HEA_EXP_013: SELECT appointment_id,status,bill_amount FROM appointments r WHERE bill_amount>(SELECT AVG(x.bill_amount) FROM appointments x WHERE x.status=r.status) ORDER BY status,bill_amount DESC;
HEA_EXP_014: SELECT r.appointment_id,MIN(e.visit_date) first_event,MAX(e.visit_date) last_event,MAX(e.visit_date)-MIN(e.visit_date) active_days FROM appointments r JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_EXP_015: SELECT visit_id,appointment_id,amount,ROUND(100.0*amount/NULLIF(SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY appointment_id),0),2) record_percent FROM visits ORDER BY appointment_id,visit_id;
HEA_EXP_016: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.patient_id,m.patient_name,m.segment,SUM(r.bill_amount) total_amount FROM patients m JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id GROUP BY m.patient_id,m.patient_name,m.segment), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amount DESC,patient_id) rn FROM totals) SELECT patient_id,patient_name,segment,total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY segment;
HEA_EXP_017: SELECT visit_id,appointment_id,amount FROM visits e WHERE amount>(SELECT AVG(x.amount) FROM visits x WHERE x.appointment_id=e.appointment_id) ORDER BY appointment_id,amount DESC;
HEA_EXP_018: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.patient_id,m.patient_name,COUNT(r.appointment_id) record_count FROM patients m LEFT JOIN appointments r ON m.patient_id=r.patient_id GROUP BY m.patient_id,m.patient_name) SELECT patient_id,patient_name,record_count FROM counts WHERE record_count>(SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts) ORDER BY record_count DESC,patient_id;
HEA_EXP_019: SELECT r.appointment_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Pending' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) pending_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) failed_amount FROM appointments r LEFT JOIN visits e ON r.appointment_id=e.appointment_id GROUP BY r.appointment_id ORDER BY r.appointment_id;
HEA_EXP_020: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY appointment_id ORDER BY visit_date DESC,visit_id DESC) rn FROM visits e) SELECT visit_id,appointment_id,visit_date,visit_type,amount,status FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY appointment_id;
